title: Complete return calendar
brief: Preserve empty periods as well as absent categories.
instructions: Return the three-reason refunded-quantity matrix for exactly twelve DATE months of UTC 2024. Fill absent reasons and months with zero.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes return_id,reason,qty,refunded_at,status from returns without solving complete return calendar.

hints.text: A calendar outer join preserves months that the pivot cannot create.
Build the observed matrix, left join it to twelve months, then fill all missing measures.
February has no refunded event in the boundary but still needs a zero row.
